title: Internal Audit Dry-Run Plan
purpose: Simulate evidence request, sampling, population reconciliation and narrative consistency before external auditor engagement.
dryRunMeaning: A simulation pass proves the P35 evidence machinery can produce a self-consistent package from a complete simulated population. It does not prove real operating effectiveness and is not an external attestation.
actualOperatingDryRunMeaning: After a real authorized evidence period, the same engine can assess the actual period. External audit readiness still requires P34 gates and auditor-defined scope.
automaticFailureConditions: operating-mode package built from simulation evidence
missing required section or artifact hash
unexplained or unresolved failed control test
synthetic evidence in a real operating period
